versions.changelog:
guaikei-xhs-kol-finder v1.0.0

- Initial release supporting 小红书 (Xiaohongshu) public data retrieval and analysis.
- Enables keyword search, note detail fetch (with comments), creator post monitoring, and standalone comment extraction.
- Delivers structured JSON for trending note mining, competitor analysis, KOL filtering, and comment insights.
- Command-line interface with flexible, high-volume batch operations—no account login required.
- Comprehensive documentation, parameter options, routing logic, and failure handling provided.
